comment: The NuGet packages the tree reads besides what the Windows App SDK release in wxl.gen/profiles/base.json ships. tools/restore-packages.ps1 fetches every one into the NuGet package folder, and nothing else downloads anything.

experimental.why: The metadata of WrapPanel and LayoutPanel: the stable WinUI package keeps them out of Microsoft.UI.Xaml.winmd, the experimental channel declares them.

The installers of the experimental Windows App Runtime (framework 2-experimentalF), which is what has the interfaces the experimental metadata declares: WrapPanel, TitleBar.RecomputeDragRegions, the size properties of Window. tools/install-runtime.ps1 installs them; the version is the newest the experimental Windows App SDK (2.5.4-experimental) depends on, whose WinUI is the 2.3.10-experimental above.
